Find reference reaches that terminate on a channel that carries on

Source: R/check_reference_severed_terminals.R
check_reference_severed_terminals.Rd

A reach with no downstream becomes a terminal nexus, and flow arriving there is not routed on. That is right for an outlet: a coast, a closed basin. It is wrong where the channel plainly continues, and a routing consumer sees the flow simply stop.

The test is geometric because the attributes cannot answer it. terminalfl is unpopulated for whole sources, and dnhydroseq is stored too narrowly to hold the values it points at. What does distinguish the two is what lies at the reach's downstream end: nothing, or another reach carrying more water than the one that just stopped.

Observed on the CONUS reference: of 15,877 terminal reaches, 822 end within a DEM cell of another reach, and 446 of those end on one that drains more, including a 324,094 km2 river in VPU 13 that stops 30 m short of its own continuation and the Saint John at Fort Kent, where 12,334 km2 stops 13 m from a reach carrying 12,363 km2. They are spread nationwide rather than gathered at the borders: VPU 17 has 76, VPU 18 69, VPU 16 68.

Report-only, and deliberately not wired into run_pipeline(). The topology belongs to the reference, and repairing it means writing edges into an input rather than working around it in a build. This reports what a staged reference still carries.

Usage

check_reference_severed_terminals(
  reference_gpkg,
  layer = "flowpaths",
  id = "flowpath_id",
  toid = "flowpath_toid",
  area = "totdasqkm",
  vpuid = NA_character_,
  tolerance_m = 30,
  strict = FALSE
)

Arguments

reference_gpkg

Path to the reference GeoPackage.

layer

Flowline layer name.

id, toid

Identifier and downstream-identifier columns.

area

Column holding total upstream drainage area, used to tell a receiver from a neighbouring headwater.

vpuid

Optional VPU to restrict to, when the layer carries vpuid.

tolerance_m

Distance within which a reach counts as ending on another. The default is the 30 m DEM cell. A wider radius reports unrelated channel heads: at 100 m VPU 01 scores 17 and at 5 m it scores none.

strict

If TRUE, warn when any are found.

Value

Invisibly, a data frame of id, area, continues_into and into_area, largest first.
